result.title: Agri-MRAG: Parameter-Enhanced Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Agricultural Visual Question Answering
result.summary: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has shown promise for Agricultural Visual Question Answering (Agri-VQA), but existing methods still face challenges in retrieving relevant knowledge while avoiding redundancy and in integrating retrieved evidence beyond simple prompt concatenation. To address these issues, we propose Agri-MRAG, a multimodal retrieval-augmented framework for agricultural VQA. Specifically, we first introduce a semantic-consistency-guided clustering mechanism that combines multimodal clustering and weighted relevance scoring to select high-confidence knowledge subsets and adaptively determine the retrieval size $k$. We then design a parameterized knowledge injection strategy, where retrieved agricultural knowledge is encoded into LoRA adapters and merged into the feed-forward network (FFN) layers of the MLLM, allowing external knowledge to influence generation through parameter-level adaptation. In addition, a perplexity-guided (PPL-guided) routing mechanism is employed to switch between implicit parametric reasoning and explicit retrieval-assisted generation according to model uncertainty, balancing inference efficiency and answer reliability. For evaluation, we use PlantVillageVQA as a broad agricultural benchmark and construct PlantVQA, a region-specific forestry and fruit crop VQA dataset containing 7,514 images and 15,028 expert-verified question-answer pairs. Experiments show that Agri-MRAG achieves ROUGE-L scores of 41.21 and 46.58 on the two datasets, outperforming mRAG by 11.70 and 4.51 points, and VisRAG by 8.80 and 3.39 points, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 Agri-MRAG 农业多模态检索增强框架：用语义一致性引导的聚类和加权相关性打分筛选知识子集并自适应确定检索规模 k，将检索到的农业知识编码为 LoRA 适配器并入 MLLM 的 FFN 层，并用困惑度引导的路由在参数化隐式推理与显式检索增强生成之间切换；同时构建了区域林业与果树 VQA 数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中基于模型不确定性的「隐式推理 / 检索生成」路由可供核查是否能类比 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的证据获取与停止决策，参数级知识注入也涉及外部证据如何进入生成过程；但工作聚焦农业领域检索增强，未分析内部 latent 状态，联系较间接。
